parameters.name: InterfaceId
parameters.description: MAC Address of the interface of the Neighbor for this {{object}}. This value comes from the neighbor’s Topology discovery message as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-9: MAC address type TLV}}.

parameters.name: IEEE1905Id
parameters.description: MAC Address of the 1905 AL entity of the Neighbor device on this {{object}}. This value comes from the neighbor’s Topology discovery message as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-8: AL MAC address type TLV}}.

parameters.name: MediaType
parameters.description: Media type of this {{object}}. This value is derived from the neighbor’s Topology response message 1905 device information type TLV Media Type field as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-12: Media type}}. {{enum}}

object.description: This object defines the 1905 neighbors and link properties.
